summary: The great tome of demonology: power over fiends, and the danger of what's bound in its pages.
text: The fullest and most blasphemous study of demons in the multiverse, this sprawling tome maps the endless layers of the Abyss and the beings that dwell there. While you are attuned, it serves as your Spellcasting Focus and gives you Advantage on saving throws against Fiends' abilities. You can cast each of these from it once per dawn: Summon Fiend (level 9), Planar Binding, and Magic Circle (level 9). Bound within the book is a demon that might attempt to escape when whoever reads it is weakened. It also has a minor beneficial property and a minor detrimental one.
